items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: See, Bonnie Biggore went with Duke Oliver and Omar Simeone, he went with Earl Hines and I, Paul Barnes, went with Jell-A-Roll-Martin.

ctx.x: I see. That's how you got up with Jell-A. Yeah, that's how I got up with Jell-A-Roll-Martin. Because King Oliver's band broke up.

See, Bonnie Biggore went with Duke Oliver and Omar Simeone, he went with Earl Hines and I, Paul Barnes, went with Jell-A-Roll-Martin. But times were tough. I bet it was. When I got to New York it was just a little before Littborg flew across the ocean. Oh yeah? Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh.
